name: Tughril I
role: Sultan of the Seljuk Empire from 1037 to 1063
contribution: A Turkoman chieftain, who founded the Seljuk Empire, ruling from 1037 to 1063.

checks.lead: Abu Talib Muhammad Tughril ibn Mika'il (Persian: ابوطالبْ محمد طغرل بن میکائیل), better known as Tughril (طغرل / طغریل; also spelled Toghril / Tughrul), was a Turkoman chieftain, who founded the Seljuk Empire, ruling from 1037 to 1063.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
